name: game-design-suite-core-v2
description: V2 preview of Game Design Suite Core. A single generalist runtime Skill for broad game-design work, cross-system reasoning, evidence discipline, and professional-domain identification without pretending to dynamically load specialist Skills.

interface.shortDescription: Generalist game-design core with explicit evidence and domain routing
interface.longDescription: A single-runtime-skill V2 preview of Game Design Suite. It remains useful as the one entry users can remember, handles broad and cross-system game-design tasks directly, identifies the relevant specialist domain, and never claims another specialist Skill was executed unless that specialist runtime actually ran.
defaultPrompt: Review this game-design problem and give me a complete answer without requiring me to know which specialist discipline owns it.
Design this system from goals through rules, metrics, risks, and validation.
Audit this cross-system design and separate facts, assumptions, candidate changes, and missing evidence.
